% Fixture for BUG-17: \newtheorem duplication in build_minimal_preamble
% When unfold.py merges a multi-file project where the same \newtheorem
% declaration appears in multiple files (e.g., a shared macros.tex that is
% \input'd by a preamble.tex and the same declaration appears in main.tex),
% build_minimal_preamble extracts all matches of _NEWTHEOREM_RE from the
% merged (unfolded) source. Duplicate declarations cause:
% "! LaTeX Error: Command \remark already defined."
%
% Paper 2602.04425 (seed 8) triggered this, showing:
%   \newtheorem{remark}{Remark}[section]
%   \newtheorem{remark}{Remark}[section]  ← duplicate
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{remark}{Remark}[section]
\newtheorem{remark}{Remark}[section]
\begin{document}
\begin{remark}
Test remark.
\end{remark}
\end{document}
